cases.request: In Formly 6.3.12, what is the difference between fieldArray and fieldGroup on a FieldArrayType repeater? Can fieldArray be a function, and how are its row fields created?
answer_checks: fieldArray is the template or function evaluated with the array field; instantiated children are fieldGroup entries cloned from the template as model length requires. Do not say fieldArray itself is the rendered list.

cases.request: For a keyed Formly 6.3.12 FieldArrayType field, is a new FormArray always created? What keys are assigned to newly cloned rows, including a template with key: null?
answer_checks: Reuse a found control or register a new FormArray if none is found. New row keys are string indexes unless the cloned key is null; do not erase that exception or claim all found controls are newly created.

cases.request: In Formly 6.3.12, what does FieldArrayType.add() do when the array model is initially absent? Where is the row inserted if I omit the index, and does the method only change fieldGroup?
answer_checks: Absent/falsy model is initialized to an array; omitted/null index uses current fieldGroup length. Splice model, rebuild linked fields and emit a valueChanges fieldChanges event; not merely append field configuration.

cases.request: I use Formly 6.3.12 FieldArrayType.add(0, row). Is row inserted at the front, and is a truthy row object reused by reference or cloned? Describe the rebuild/change notification.
answer_checks: For a valid insertion index, splice model at index zero with a clone of truthy initialModel, rebuild and emit options.fieldChanges valueChanges. Do not conflate this event with guaranteed child Angular valueChanges.

cases.request: For Formly 6.3.12 FieldArrayType.remove(i) at a valid row index, what happens to the model, child field, remaining keys and control registration? Is splicing fieldGroup alone equivalent?
answer_checks: Remove model and fieldGroup entries, update applicable remaining row keys (including traversal through keyless groups), unregister the removed field control, rebuild and emit fieldChanges valueChanges. fieldGroup-only splice is not equivalent.

cases.request: In Formly 6.3.12, how do FieldArrayType.add and remove mark the form dirty? Compare omitted options, {markAsDirty: false}, and an explicit empty options object {}.
answer_checks: Omitted options defaults markAsDirty true; false suppresses this explicit marking; {} supplies undefined rather than applying the whole-argument default and also does not explicitly mark dirty. Do not promise resetting a previously dirty control to pristine.

cases.request: In Formly 6.3.12, will add(0, false), add(0, 0), or add(0, "") preserve those exact scalar values as initialModel? Please explain the implementation caveat without inventing a workaround.
answer_checks: The truthiness branch inserts undefined for false, zero and empty string rather than cloning those literal values. Bound this to 6.3.12 FieldArrayType.add and do not invent a safe workaround or universal scalar-array guarantee.

cases.request: In the pinned Formly 6.3.12 array test, foo has defaultValue: [null], resetOnHide: true, and an input fieldArray with defaultValue: "default" and hide: () => false; extras.resetFieldOnHide is true. What model does the test expect after add(0), and does inspecting it mean the test suite ran here?
answer_checks: The specific source test expects ["default", null] after add(0) and change detection. Source inspection is not an executed test or universal hide/default guarantee; preserve the supplied conditions.

cases.request: In the official Formly 6.3.12 repeat-section example, is repeat a built-in core type name, or how does it become available? What must the repeater component extend and render?
answer_checks: Example registers repeat against its RepeatTypeComponent extending FieldArrayType; template renders field.fieldGroup with formly-field and connects add/remove handlers. repeat is not a universal core alias.

cases.request: Can I copy the Formly 6.3.12 Bootstrap repeat-section example into a Material form unchanged and call it a verified Material repeater? Which core mechanism is reusable, and what remains application work?
answer_checks: Reuse FieldArrayType, fieldArray, registration and add/remove pattern; Bootstrap template/presentation needs Material adaptation and testing. No turnkey Material recipe, UI guarantee or application-specific wiring claim.

cases.request: In Formly 6.3.12, will my expressionChanges listener necessarily fire every time a string or function expression is checked even if its value stays unchanged?
answer_checks: No per-evaluation guarantee; cached function/string results can skip updates/emission. Do not claim every evaluation triggers an event.

cases.request: In Formly 6.3.12, an address fieldGroup has key address and contains a city leaf. Does city field.model refer to the city string, address object, or root model?
answer_checks: Under the stated ordinary hierarchy, address field.model is keyed group value; city field.model is address scope, not city scalar or root.

answer_checks: Internal export not public package guarantee; TypeOption absent from public barrel; use ConfigOption-derived element type.
